contract: Whether the vendor's own name/logo ("Scheduling by <APP_NAME>") is appended to a message must be resolved for the EVENT being booked — the event type's team (with its parent-organization override) or its owning user's profile organization — via the centralized resolver in packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts, and every automation/workflow path must resolve it the same way the public booking page does; no caller may substitute the raw `eventType.owner.hideBranding` column or the workflow's own owner/team.

defect_location.summary: The booking page resolves branding event-scoped and org-aware: apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:299-302 calls shouldHideBrandingForUserEvent, apps/web/lib/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.tsx:199-202 and apps/web/app/(booking-page-wrapper)/team/[slug]/[type]/pageWithCachedData.tsx:36-39 call shouldHideBrandingForTeamEvent, and apps/web/modules/bookings/views/bookings-single-view.getServerSideProps.tsx:251-258 and packages/features/ee/payments/pages/payment.tsx:58-63 call shouldHideBrandingForEvent — all of which route through resolveHideBranding in packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45, where an organization-level setting overrides the entity's own (team.parent.hideBranding at :96-99, owner.profile.organization.hideBranding at :101-104). The automation path does not. Every workflow trigger site instead reads the raw owner column: packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts:2618, :2793, :2808 (`!!eventType.owner?.hideBranding`), packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:459 and :472, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:471, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleBookingRequested.ts:112 (type at :30-32), packages/features/handleMarkNoShow.ts:377, packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/confirm.handler.ts:561, packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:230, packages/features/ee/round-robin/roundRobinManualReassignment.ts:671, and packages/features/ee/managed-event-types/reassignment/services/ManagedEventManualReassignmentService.ts:188 — which is null for team events and blind to the parent-organization override. Separately, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:90-93 recomputes it from the WORKFLOW's own owner (`getHideBranding({ userId: workflow.userId, teamId: workflow.teamId })`) rather than the booked event, and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/WorkflowService.ts:133-136 does the same from the routing form's owner. The wrong value is carried through packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/reminderScheduler.ts:56,97,161,213,248,262,280, scheduleMandatoryReminder.ts:18,27,82 and emailReminderManager.ts:38,115,147,182,204, and is finally rendered as the vendor footer at packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/templates/customTemplate.ts:216, templates/emailReminderTemplate.ts:82-83 and templates/emailRatingTemplate.ts:79-80. The selects feeding these sites only fetch `owner.hideBranding` (packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/getEventTypesFromDB.ts:109-113, handleConfirmation.ts:309-313 and :359-363, packages/features/bookings/lib/getBookingToDelete.ts:54-59, packages/features/bookings/repositories/BookingRepository.ts:450-456) and must widen to team + parent.
